effect_on_terminal_verdict: For the current evidence snapshot, absence of required direct evidence forces INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE unless a verified MATERIAL_RISK_FOUND takes precedence.
reopen_conditions: Admit fresh directly comparable evidence meeting the frozen F180 evidence-admission schema.
